title: Accent emphasis reaches a demo-owned kit text slot: the writer is told, W16 and the site check accent-emphasis judge it, the export wraps it
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/accent-demo-owned-slots.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail and skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 5 passing tests, 0 failures and 0 skipped.
A hero heading the kit lists under demoOwned with an inline span appears in the writer's block view with its inline note and limit.
W16 fails that heading with cause missing when the copy names no emphasis and passes it with an emphasis of its own words.
The export writes the emphasis wrapped in the demo span; the site check blocks the heading printed with no span, on step 6.
evidence: 06/11/2026: a real site copy wrote the JA Boxing home hero heading (a demo-owned slot whose demo draws NO1 in the accent span) plain, and the copy check and the step 11 site check stayed green.
fence: Pure functions over an invented kit, plan and copy. Not exercised: a live writer run, the plugin write, a page read by the host.
